Lane ownership remained 015 only. Package and manifest were re-read before mutation; active foreign 014/016/017/018 files were not edited. The unidentified port-8805 service returned 404 on health and root routes and was treated as foreign.

Fresh public-lobby semantic and coordinate clicks on the enabled Mirror Core mode card left server mode in race. Enter activated the separate global start handler and was excluded from mode-selection proof. The server /api/mode route itself remained functional and authoritative.

Source inspection identified a client cached-phase veto in selectMode and silent error swallowing as a plausible contributor. The client guard was removed so visible controls ask the server; accepted/refused status feedback was added while core setMode retained its non-lobby mode-locked rejection.

Added frozen START_GRID_MOMENTS and pure axm.start-grid-pose/v1 for Mike ratchet-ready, Axiom/Mir signal-synced, Codex compile-armed, and Mirror vector-returned. Poses are finite, bounded, reduced-motion static, changesPerformance=false, and changesAuthority=false.

Integrated a four-seat semantic countdown roster, authority-derived character/vehicle assignments and mode-aware heading, responsive four-column/two-by-two composition, axm.start-grid-diagnostics/v1 DOM disclosure, and presentation-only animation without changing launch timing or server state.

Added tests/start-grid.test.js and evidence/start-grid-contract.md. The focused test passed 112 bounded poses across four identities, four seats, six times plus reduced motion, distinct moments, authority immutability, server mode lock, static wiring, and frozen 260/178/2.45, +7.5 percent, 85 percent attack, three-guard contracts.

Promoted package and manifest to 0.22.0 / PLAYABLE ALPHA V22 START GRID, registered the new test and evidence contract, declared four entrants and both no-performance/no-authority boundaries, and retained every prior route, replay, mode, LAN, and recorder contract.

The first combined regression attempt failed only because the unchanged Mirror Echo file's cache query was unnecessarily advanced to V22 while the existing selftest correctly expected v0.21.0. This was an asset-version assertion failure, not gameplay counterevidence.
Restored the unchanged mirror-echo.js query to v0.21.0; game-core.js and app.js retained v0.22.0 cache keys. No production behavior, test threshold, or evidence boundary was weakened.

The complete suite passed 36 focused checks, 45,504 interpolation poses and 864 snaps, 108,000 kinetic poses, 112 result poses, 112 start-grid poses, reflection, echo, recorder, LAN, race, track, variant, battle, tour, reliability, restart, and HTTP coverage.

Live mode selection still failed after removing the cached-phase veto. Read-only elementsFromPoint evidence showed the invisible race HUD item button above the Mirror Core card. The V21 stale-guard explanation was therefore incomplete; hidden HUD pointer ownership was the primary blocker.

Visibility-gated raceHud whenever aria-hidden=true so pointer-active descendants cannot intercept the lobby. Elevated the countdown reveal above the visible racing HUD to prevent player/item panels from overlapping Start Grid cards. Static regressions now lock both seams.

At 1280x720, the public Mirror Core control changed server mode to battle and aria-pressed=true. Its public start action rendered four distinct ready cards under MIRROR CORE // FOUR SIGNALS ARMED with no HUD overlap or document overflow, then transitioned into server phase racing.

At explicit 390x844, public controls selected Signal Tour and rendered a complete two-by-two four-card grid inside a 372.8 by 734.4 countdown; document scroll width equalled the 390-pixel viewport and every card stayed inside the frame.

Public responsive controls selected Circuit Crown, Splitglass Gardens, reflection direction, and Shardline Sprint. The countdown heading read SPLITGLASS GARDENS // REFLECT // SPRINT, exposed four cards, axm.start-grid-diagnostics/v1, four entrants, changesAuthority=false, and no horizontal overflow.

Browser warning/error logs were empty across battle, tour, and reflection-race journeys. Repeated stills and DOM pose progression prove rendered states and responsive composition only; no rolling buffer existed, so high-cadence motion remains unknown. Browser views are not phones.

Added visual.motion.start-grid as available only at its bounded local contract. Requirements/capabilities/report compare semantically with overall UNKNOWN and zero missing declarations; physical, target-performance, listening, human-preference, art-direction, content-breadth, and steward gates remain open.

After the interaction/layout corrections and evidence promotion, npm.cmd test passed again. The final accelerated 30-virtual-minute rotation recorded 1,800 acknowledged actions, 59 resumes, 12 settled results, and 7.5 MB heap delta; it is not a real-time hardware soak.

All 24 lane JSON files parsed; the focused selftest passed 36 checks; the independent semantic capability check reported UNKNOWN with zero missing and start-grid available. Package and manifest required paths include the new contract and test.

Browser stills remained ephemeral tool output, healthy polls were aggregated, and no raw screenshot/video, temporary comparator, private session identifier, canonical asset, user source, or foreign-lane file was deleted or retained as session evidence.

Goal remains open. Four real phones on the intended router for 30 minutes, representative target-hardware performance and high-cadence observation, human listening/mix, character attachment and replay/route preference, deeper animation/voice/authored content, independent art direction, and explicit steward approval remain unproven; no AAA achievement is claimed.
